label: Verify an image or a video
description: Where an image or a video first appeared, whether what is said about it holds, and the signs of editing or generation: first sightings dated on a timeline, metadata, C2PA, reverse search

inputs.label: Claim to test (date, place, event)
inputs.placeholder: The Temple of Diana in Mérida during the storm of 3 March 2025

criteria.high: the earliest dated copy is read and archived, and every engine and the archives found nothing earlier
criteria.medium: an early dated copy, some engines or archives unchecked
criteria.low: a single page, or a date read from metadata only

criteria.high: a contradiction read or computed (another place identified, an earlier copy, the weather or the sun of that day), or every part of the claim checked and consistent
criteria.medium: consistent clues, the place or the date unchecked
criteria.low: only the caption and the page that carries it

criteria.high: a signed and valid C2PA manifest of the original says how it was made
criteria.medium: metadata, the embedded thumbnail and a close look at hands, text and shadows agree
criteria.low: a single sign, or a stripped file with nothing to read

max.why: signs of editing or generation are clues, never a verdict: only a signed and valid C2PA manifest of the original goes above medium

actions.label: Search X, Telegram, TikTok and YouTube

bins.off: metadata limited to JPEG/PNG EXIF read by the GeoINT pack; video, XMP and IPTC unread
no video frames; masks fall back on the GeoINT pack's Pillow
a video given by link must be downloaded by hand
reverse image search by link (Lens, Bing, TinEye, Yandex, Baidu) is off (cloudflared needs no account); Yandex/Baidu direct upload still works

packs.off: no direct Yandex/Baidu upload for verify-media; the tunnel's links still work
